# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2. Note down the exact violations of safety standards and regulations.
3. Examine the compliance certificates thoroughly.
4. Investigate the incident thoroughly.
5. Determine the root causes of the incident.
6. Record the response of the factory management.
7. Gather sufficient evidence to substantiate the findings.
8. Write the concluding statement about potential causes.
9. Ensure the accuracy of all data.
